podcast.body: Released on July 23rd, 1999, this full-length album was recorded with producer Brad Nelson (known for working with The Headstones) and Darryl Smith at Tattoo Music, a jingle studio where they recorded for free at night. The band self-produced 500 copies using Aaron Solowaniak's credit card and promoted it independently, earning positive reviews at Canadian Music Week despite having no label or official management. "Oh, yeah, we did a full length, yeah, with Darryl Smith, a chemical sound, and that came at Brad Nelson. That was 99. Yeah, Darryl Smith, Dan Brad Nelson at... Yeah, that was Wattouche. That was Wattouche. And that one's still available."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
